title: 2nd Annual Roger Murray lecture series: A Conversation with Richard Thaler and Tano Santos
summary: The discussion highlights how specific companies achieved success through 'brilliant choice architecture' that simplifies user interaction. Amazon is noted for organizing its massive inventory to allow users to find any book with a couple of clicks. Apple's features, specifically the iPhone, are praised because users could open the device and immediately start using it without reading a lengthy instruction manual. Netflix is also cited as a company that succeeded by allowing users to watch content easily.
